intro: Yemen has over 35 million people, one of the youngest populations in the Arab world.

chapters.title: People
text: Almost all Yemenis are Arab Muslims, with Zaydi Shia in the north and Sunni Muslims elsewhere. Most people live in villages in the highlands.
War has forced millions from their homes, and most people need humanitarian aid.

chapters.title: Tribes
text: Tribes play a big part in society, especially in the north.

keyTerms.meaning: A branch of Shia Islam found in northern Yemen.
